text:
Sam: Quick alert — nightly invoice run_2026_03_27_02 produced ~30 invoices with missing prorated seat lines and 9 customers got duplicate PDFs. Opening thread to triage.
Ivy: can you share sample invoice ids?
Sam: INV-NEB-0042, INV-CORE-110, INV-VOLT-909. customers: acct-nebula, acct-corelabs, acct-voltix.
Noah: pulled logs. renderer hit an AggregationAborted during line-item assembly then retried the render without the idempotency_key. partial invoice object -> missing lines; retry -> duplicate PDF. log snippet:
```
2026-03-27T07:18:02Z ERROR invoice_agg: AggregationAborted invoice=INV-NEB-0042
2026-03-27T07:18:03Z WARN queue: requeued job job=55821 idempotency_key=null
2026-03-27T07:18:04Z INFO pdf: wrote tmp/inv_INV-NEB-0042_part.pdf
```
Priya: collections hold for affected accounts. CS ticket FIN-10345 opened by acct-nebula at 07:25 UTC.
Ivy: finance exposure estimate?
Sam: quick calc ~ $1,100 (prorations + one onboarding fee). will refine after list.
Noah: hotfix plan: thread idempotency_key through aggregation+render stages, write PDFs atomically (tmp+rename), add dedupe guard on PDF store. Deploy + backfill ~90m.
Ivy: pause nightly job until fix is live.
Noah: paused: `systemctl stop invoice-nightly` on batch04. deploying billing/invoice-idempotency-fix to staging.
billing-bot: Deploy started for billing/invoice-idempotency-fix -> staging
Priya: CS will hold outbound messages until regen completes. offering $20 courtesy credit.
Noah: dry-run backfill: `python billing/backfill.py --run run_2026_03_27_02 --dry-run` -> found 30 invoices missing lines, 9 duplicates.
Sam: ok. don't issue credits until we confirm final numbers.
billing-bot: Deploy to production succeeded @ 2026-03-27T09:10:12Z
Noah: prod backfill finished: regenerated 30 invoices, removed 9 duplicates, uploaded corrected PDFs, queued email resend. summary: regenerated=30 deduped=9 duration=34m
Ivy: finance to prepare credits and journals after CS confirms sends. tagging owners: Noah (fix+backfill), Priya (CS), Ivy (finance). Add postmortem after incident closed.
